title: 第25章 小因果的另外一种用法第26章 局里有人好办事
content_zh:
;;
黄帝陵旁边新的建筑地下已经修成了一座类似于堡垒一样的基地，而且还在迅速扩建之中。
从郝科这里，敖鹏才了解到这里就是民调局的总部所在，也保卫着帝国最重要的资产。
穿行在地堡之中，分不清上下左右，敖鹏大概走了六分钟，过了三层严密的检测网，然后来到了一间几千平的巨大训练场。
训练场的地面是一种他辨认不出的材料，踩上去像草，有很好的缓冲力。
四周的墙壁都是高强度的金属，单单是这个训练场价值就难以估量。
训练场中间有四位大佬，一位军队的，一位行政的，两者的穿着都可以直接看出来。
另外两人白发苍苍，应该就是国宝级的大师和科学家。
“太市民调局第一科科长郝行携组员敖鹏见过各位领导。”
敖鹏跟着上前说道，“见过各位领导。”
四位大佬和蔼可亲，看向敖鹏，笑道，“不用拘谨，只是一个简单的小测试。”
然后其中一位问道，“你可以先简单阐述一下你的神通及其作用，放心，你的神通只要验证成功，那么自动就会录入机密文库，我们在场的几人都会立下誓言，不会对外泄露你的神通特点。”
神通很多时候都直接决定一场战斗的胜负，帝国也不想要自己人的神通弄得天下皆知。
这是应有的过程，敖鹏回答道，“我的神通种子叫做‘小因果’，现在的能力是完整承受一次对方的攻击，无论什么属性，但必须要完整承受，然后再返还一次相同的攻击，只不过只能够返还给施加攻击的那个人，不能够影响其他人。”
敖鹏隐瞒了双倍攻击的事情。
但即使这样，在场其他五人也眼前一亮。
“因果律的神通？！”
“稀罕啊！”
“郝行，你这次可真的捡到了宝贝了！”
因果律武器的作用自不必多说，在场人都心知肚明。

这时候身穿军装的老者对着旁边穿着民国时代长袍的老者说道，“墨老，麻烦你了。”
墨老微微点头，然后看向敖鹏，“小同志，接下来我会使用一种禁锢手段，不会造成伤害，你不要紧张。”
敖鹏轻轻点头。
见敖鹏同意了之后，墨老凌空摸出一支大号泼墨毛笔，然后对着敖鹏一点。
明明两者之间有四五米的距离，但是一股如墨水般的黑暗竟然从敖鹏脚底升起，逐渐将他的身体染黑。
这种黑暗还不仅仅只是禁锢他的身体，甚至连他的意识都逐渐拖入黑暗之中。
好在墨老并没有真正杀意，一边使用自己的能力，一边还笑着解释道，“这是我的神通种子‘黑白’。”
敖鹏神色凝重，因为墨老的神通实在是有些惊人！
他被黑墨浸染的身体就像是不存在一样，任凭他怎么想要动脚，但是大脑却认定他天生就没有‘脚’！
如果被黑墨侵染全身，是不是他也会被认定不存在？
到时候就算是想要发动‘小因果’的神通，恐怕也不能如愿了。
好在墨老只是染黑了敖鹏的小腿便停了下来，用鼓励的语气对敖鹏说道，“你试试？”
敖鹏连忙点头，伸手同样对着墨老一指。
墨老也从脚下升起一团黑墨，不断向上覆盖。
墨老没有丝毫的惊慌，反而认真体悟了一下敖鹏通过‘小因果’返还黑白神通的不同。
随后他笑了笑，自己伸手一抹，不但解除了敖鹏身上的黑白神通，连他自己的黑白神通都一并抹消。

A base similar to a fortress has been built underground in the new building next to the Yellow Emperor's Mausoleum, and it is still being rapidly expanded.
From Hao Ke, Ao Peng learned that this was the headquarters of the Polling Bureau, which also protected the empire's most important assets.
Walking through the bunker, unable to tell the difference between up, down, left and right, Ao Peng walked for about six minutes, passed three layers of strict inspection nets, and then came to a huge training ground measuring several thousand square meters.
The ground of the training ground was made of a material he couldn't identify. It felt like grass and had good cushioning.
The surrounding walls are made of high-strength metal, and the value of this training ground alone is inestimable.
There are four big bosses in the middle of the training ground, one from the military and one from the administration. You can directly tell by their clothes.
The other two people are white-haired and should be national treasure-level masters and scientists.
"Hao Xing, chief of the first section of the Taipei Municipal Investigation Bureau, and team member Ao Peng met with all the leaders."
Ao Peng stepped forward and said, "I've met all the leaders."
The four bosses looked at Ao Peng and said with a smile, "No need to be formal, it's just a simple test."
Then one of them asked, "You can briefly explain your magical power and its function first. Don't worry, as long as your magical power is successfully verified, it will automatically be entered into the confidential library. Several of us present will swear an oath not to leak the characteristics of your magical power to the outside world."
Many times, magical powers directly determine the outcome of a battle, and the empire does not want its own magical powers to be known to the world.
This is the process that should be done, Ao Peng replied, "My magical seed is called 'Little Cause and Effect'. My current ability is to completely withstand the opponent's attack, no matter what the attribute is, but it must be fully withstood, and then return the same attack again, but it can only be returned to the person who made the attack, and cannot affect other people."
Ao Peng concealed the double attack.
But even so, the eyes of the other five people present also brightened.
"The magical power of the law of cause and effect?!"
"Rare!"
"Hao Xing, you really found a treasure this time!"
Needless to say, the function of the law of cause and effect weapon is well understood by everyone present.
At this time, the old man in military uniform said to the old man wearing a robe from the Republic of China era next to him, "Mr. Mo, I'm sorry to bother you."
Mr. Mo nodded slightly, then looked at Ao Peng, "Little comrade, I will use a restraint method next, which will not cause harm. Don't be nervous."
Ao Peng nodded slightly.
After seeing that Ao Peng agreed, Mr. Mo took out a large splash-ink brush and pointed it at Ao Peng.
There was obviously a distance of four or five meters between the two, but a darkness like ink rose from the soles of Ao Peng's feet, gradually turning his body black.
This darkness not only imprisoned his body, but also gradually dragged his consciousness into darkness.
Fortunately, Mr. Mo didn't really have any killing intention. While using his ability, he explained with a smile, "This is my magical seed 'Black and White'."
Ao Peng looked solemn, because Mr. Mo's magical powers were really amazing!
His body soaked in black ink seemed to not exist. No matter how much he wanted to move his feet, his brain determined that he was born without "feet"!
If his whole body is infected with black ink, will he also be deemed to not exist?
At that time, even if you want to activate the magical power of 'little cause and effect', you may not be able to do so.
Fortunately, Mr. Mo only dyed Ao Peng's calves black and then stopped, and said to Ao Peng in an encouraging tone, "You try?"
Ao Peng nodded quickly and pointed at Mr. Mo as well.
A ball of black ink also rose from Mr. Mo's feet, covering it upwards.
Mr. Mo didn't panic at all, but seriously realized the difference between Ao Peng's return of black and white magical powers through 'little cause and effect'.
Then he smiled, stretched out his hand and touched it. Not only did Ao Peng's black and white magical powers disappear, but also his ownAll the black and white magical powers were wiped away.
